title: Ramli names the scale first
body:
Back from the coastal landing, Musa sends Ramli ahead of the Arus's baskets. Ramli names the scale before he says a number. Jalal of Sonargaon wants some of the tin, but his partner will not buy while the two tallies seem to disagree.

Musa asks if a weigher can witness both readings before Jalal's partner closes his stall. The ordinary weighing fee will be entered in the temenggung's name either way.

choices.label: Ask a weigher to witness both readings now
choices.outcome_text: The readings agree. Jalal takes his lot; two local buyers divide the rest after seeing the same weighing.

choices.label: Keep the weigher on the work already in hand
choices.outcome_text: Jalal's partner closes the stall and takes the cash home. Musa sells a little locally and keeps the rest aboard for his next stop.

notes: gameplay: Staff scheduling, the second weighing and the effect deltas are game abstractions (docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §§02, 08; data/merchants/awang_musa.json)
